response.narration:
You will your body to be vast, to hold nine hundred and ninety-nine lives' worth of vigor, and the world does not answer. Your wounds still ache beneath your scales, and the grey river keeps its pace below the bridge. A body is not rewritten by wanting; it is only made by what it endures.

Captain Orrel watches you from the parapet, one brow raised at the silence you've held a moment too long. "Road's long enough without arguing with yourself," he says. "You look half-spent. Rest here, or press north?"
